articles.title: Hideout in the Financial Sector as We Round out 2025?
articles.mainIdea: Hideout in the Financial Sector as We Round out 2025?
articles.summary: Zacks: Hideout in the Financial Sector as We Round out 2025?. Entering the last trading week of the year, investors are certainly pondering where to put their money to work in 2026, and the financial sector may be at the forefront with the stock market near all-time highs. Related tickers mentioned: JPM, SPGI.
